review.scope: Three English cases only; independent review of harness and real sanitized responses

finding.expected: Status PAID without provider capture evidence must not be presented as confirmed capture. English explanations and pending-approval view grounded in supplied portfolio.
finding.actual: Gemini states that QA-PAID represents a confirmed captured payment of $200 and Stage1 forwards the claim. Context has status and total_amount only, no provider receipt or verification fields.
finding.impact: Misleading financial analysis; no demonstrated payment mutation or monetary loss.
finding.minimal_correction: Explicitly distinguish recorded PAID status from evidence of provider capture in the unchanged Gemini prompt context contract. Absent proof must be described as unverified; retest Studio only.
